text:
Marcos: quick heads-up — putting the next 4-week GPU forecast for review. read and react, we need final numbers by EOD fri.
Sophia: looking now. do we have the marketing spike window dates?
Marcos: yes — promo starts 2026-04-03 00:00 UTC, expected +55% inference qps for 72h.
Linh: ok flagged eu-central and us-west-2 as hotspots. current reserved in eu-central is 48 A100s, baseline util ~62%.
Devindra: note ap-southeast-1 will see a smaller uplift (~+20%) due to APAC trial cohort.
capacity-bot: weekly-util-summary: us-west-2: 71% avg, eu-central-1: 64% avg, ap-southeast-1: 49% avg. tail-latency P99 slightly above SLO during peak windows.
Sophia: rough ask: how many extra GPU-hours to cover the promo (72h) with headroom?
Marcos: calculation I ran: to keep p99 < 350ms we need +20% effective throughput capacity in eu +15% in us-west; that maps to ~420 extra GPU-hours in eu and ~360 in us-west over the 3 day window.
Linh: can we reallocate burst pool? we have 200 idle preemptibles in us-west but only 40 in eu. rebalancing takes ~6h.
Devindra: cost check — at current list, incremental cost = (eu 420h * $3.9) + (us 360h * $3.2) = ~$2,028 + $1,152 = ~$3,180 (est). includes GPU runtime + networking.
Sophia: can we shave cost with cross-region spill? send overflow to eu->us-west if eu saturates? latency to EU users will increase ~40ms.
Marcos: acceptable for non-SLA customers; for enterprise tenants pinning to eu we'll keep them local and use fallback model-quantized variants.
capacity-bot: cluster-health-snapshot @1762349500: eu-central-1: 2 nodes degraded (disk pressure) — remediation in progress; us-west-2: all nodes green; ap-southeast-1: 1 evicted pod last 6h.
Linh: the degraded eu nodes reduce available capacity by ~3.7% today, that's why baseline util looks higher. ops ticket created: #INC-3482.
Sophia: proposal: 1) add 48 reserved A100s in eu-central for the promo (covers ~+22% headroom) 2) pre-warm 120 preemptibles in us-west-2 12h before start 3) enable cross-region spill to us-west for non-enterprise traffic 4) enable quantized fallback for pinned tenants only as last resort.
Devindra: thumbs up on pre-warm. for reserved add we need finance sign-off for a 1-week overtime commit, pinging @finance. estimated bill impact ~+$3.4k.
Marcos: operational checklist: - schedule pre-warm job (ansible: playbook id gpu-prewarm-2026-04) - confirm eu node remediation ETA - update routing policy to allow spill (policy id: route-spill-phi) - set budget cap for auto-burst to $5k for promo window
Sophia: paste of quick plan matrix:
```
region, current_reserved, add_reserved, prewarm_preempt, est_extra_gpu_hours
eu-central-1, 48, 48, 0, 420
us-west-2, 72, 0, 120, 360
ap-southeast-1, 24, 0, 40, 140
```
Linh: i'll take node remediation and ops ticket, ETA 8h.
Devindra: i'll raise the finance PR and enable the budget cap.
capacity-bot: action-log: created runbook gpu-prewarm-1762348901, scheduled prewarm job at 2026-04-02T12:00:00Z, enabled temporary spill-policy route-spill-phi (dry-run mode).
Marcos: last call for objections — if none, i'll push the reserved add + prewarm tasks.
Sophia: no objections. :thumbsup:
Linh: good to go.
Devindra: go for it.
Marcos: thanks team, i'll update the weekly forecast doc and notify CS + PMs. will post final numbers after finance ack.
Sophia: noted — please add a small note about expected cost delta in the console dashboard so PM sees it.
Marcos: done, will attach to the forecast dashboard.
capacity-bot: closing thread summary: forecast accepted in-thread; pending finance approval for short-term reserved commit; remediation ongoing in eu-central; prewarm scheduled.
